sql:
with redemptions as (
  select
    cr.coupon_id,
    c.code as coupon_code,
    d.kind as discount_kind,
    cr.user_id,
    cr.redeemed_at,
    cr.discount_amount / er.rate as discount_amount_eur,
    row_number() over (partition by cr.coupon_id, cr.user_id order by cr.redeemed_at asc, cr.id asc) as rn
  from coupon_redemptions cr
  join coupons c on c.id = cr.coupon_id
  join discounts d on d.id = c.discount_id
  join exchange_rates er
    on er.base_code = 'EUR'
   and er.quote_code = cr.currency_code
   and er.as_of = cast(cr.redeemed_at as date)
  where cr.redeemed_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01'
    and cr.redeemed_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
)
select
  coupon_code,
  discount_kind,
  count(*) as total_redemptions_2025,
  count(distinct user_id) as distinct_customers_2025,
  count(*) - count(distinct user_id) as redemptions_beyond_first_use,
  round(sum(discount_amount_eur), 2) as total_discount_amount_eur,
  round(sum(discount_amount_eur) filter (where rn > 1), 2) as discount_amount_beyond_first_use_eur,
  round(100.0 * sum(discount_amount_eur) filter (where rn > 1) / nullif(sum(discount_amount_eur), 0), 2) as pct_of_discount_from_repeat_use
from redemptions
group by coupon_id, coupon_code, discount_kind
order by discount_amount_beyond_first_use_eur desc nulls last, coupon_code asc
limit 20
note: Grain is one row per coupon (coupon_id), shown by its code; since coupon codes are unique only per tenant, the same code text could in principle appear on two rows if two different merchants happen to reuse it. Rows with no repeat redemptions show 0 / null pct and sort to the bottom; the printed report footer will show the total distinct-coupon row count as usual.
